import edu.ucr.cs.bdlab.beast.geolite.Feature
import edu.ucr.cs.bdlab.beast.io.FeatureReader
import org.locationtech.jts.geom.CoordinateXY
import edu.ucr.cs.bdlab.davinci.IntermediateVectorTile

// Caller-owned low-level construction
val factory = FeatureReader.DefaultGeometryFactory
val geom = factory.createPoint(new CoordinateXY(1000.0, 1000.0))

// Attribute values MUST be typed as Array[Any] in Scala
val f1 = Feature.create(
  geom,
  Array("id", "name"),
  null,
  Array[Any](1, "point1")
)

// Instantiate the canonical receiver directly (resolution, buffer)
val tile = new IntermediateVectorTile(4096, 16)

// Mutates the tile in place and returns the tile itself
val resultTile = tile.addFeature(f1)

// Verify the contract: addFeature must return the mutated instance (this) for method chaining
assert(resultTile eq tile, "addFeature did not return the same IntermediateVectorTile instance")

println(s"__CHECK__ addFeature ${resultTile != null}")

import org.apache.hadoop.fs.Path

val rasterPath = new Path(raster_tif)
val rasterDir = rasterPath.getParent.toString
val indexFile = new Path(output_dir, "_index.csv").toString

edu.ucr.cs.bdlab.raptor.RasterFileRDD.buildIndex(sc, rasterDir, indexFile)

val fs = new Path(indexFile).getFileSystem(sc.hadoopConfiguration)
val inputStream = fs.open(new Path(indexFile))
val indexLines = scala.io.Source.fromInputStream(inputStream).getLines().toList
inputStream.close()

val indexSize = indexLines.size
assert(indexSize > 0, "Index file should not be empty")
assert(indexLines.exists(_.contains(rasterPath.getName)), "Index file should contain the raster file name")

println(s"__CHECK__ buildIndex $indexSize")

)

val numPartitions0 = hist.getNumPartitions(0)
assert(numPartitions0 > 0, "Histogram must have a strictly positive number of partitions in dimension 0")

)

import java.awt.geom.Rectangle2D
import org.apache.hadoop.fs.Path
import edu.ucr.cs.bdlab.raptor.HDF4Reader

// Create a bounding box in Sinusoidal space by converting degrees to radians and scaling
val rect = new Rectangle2D.Double(
  Math.toRadians(-145.0) * HDF4Reader.Scale,
  Math.toRadians(5.0) * HDF4Reader.Scale,
  Math.toRadians(29.0) * HDF4Reader.Scale,
  Math.toRadians(49.0) * HDF4Reader.Scale
)

// Create the PathFilter for HDF tiles
val filter = HDF4Reader.createTileIDFilter(rect)

// Test the filter against paths with standard MODIS hxxvyy tile identifiers
val pathAccepted = new Path("MOD13Q1.A2019001.h03v05.006.2019017233628.hdf")
val pathRejected = new Path("MOD13Q1.A2019001.h00v00.006.2019017233628.hdf")

val isAccepted = filter.accept(pathAccepted)
val isRejected = filter.accept(pathRejected)

// Verify that the filter correctly accepts intersecting tiles and rejects non-intersecting ones
assert(isAccepted, "Filter should accept tile h03v05 which intersects the bounding box")
assert(!isRejected, "Filter should reject tile h00v00 which is outside the bounding box")

println(s"__CHECK__ createTileIDFilter accepted: $isAccepted, rejected: $isRejected")

}

val path = new org.apache.hadoop.fs.Path(raster_tif)
val fs = path.getFileSystem(sc.hadoopConfiguration)
val reader = new edu.ucr.cs.bdlab.beast.io.GeoTiffReader[Float]()
reader.initialize(fs, raster_tif, "0", new edu.ucr.cs.bdlab.beast.common.BeastOptions())

val metadata = reader.metadata
// Calculate the center of the raster in world coordinates to ensure we hit a valid tile
val x = metadata.getMinX() + (metadata.getMaxX() - metadata.getMinX()) / 2.0
val y = metadata.getMinY() + (metadata.getMaxY() - metadata.getMinY()) / 2.0

// Fetch the correct tile using world coordinates first
val tileId = metadata.getTileIDAtPoint(x, y)
val tile = reader.readTile(tileId)

// Query the pixel value at the geographic location
val value = tile.getPointValue(x, y)

// Verify determinism of the point value extraction
val valueAgain = tile.getPointValue(x, y)
assert(value == valueAgain, "getPointValue should be deterministic for the same world coordinates")

println(s"__CHECK__ getPointValue $value")

import edu.ucr.cs.bdlab.beast.geolite.IFeature

// 1. Instance method (safely skips null attributes)
val feature = featuresRDD.first()
val featureSize: Int = feature.getStorageSize

// 2. Companion object method (DOES NOT handle nulls safely)
val stringValue = "sample_string"
val stringSize: Int = IFeature.getStorageSize(stringValue, StringType)

val intValue = 42
val intSize: Int = IFeature.getStorageSize(intValue, IntegerType)

// Verify the companion object method computes expected byte sizes for known types
val expectedStringSize = stringValue.getBytes.length
assert(stringSize == expectedStringSize, s"Expected string storage size to be $expectedStringSize bytes, but got $stringSize")
assert(intSize == 4, s"Expected integer storage size to be 4 bytes, but got $intSize")

// Verify the instance method returns a valid size
assert(featureSize >= 0, s"Expected feature storage size to be non-negative, but got $featureSize")

println(s"__CHECK__ getStorageSize featureSize=$featureSize, stringSize=$stringSize, intSize=$intSize")

val entries = Seq("file1.txt", "file2.txt", "file3.txt")
for (name <- entries) {
  zipOut.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry(name))
  zipOut.write(s"Content of $name".getBytes("UTF-8"))
  zipOut.closeEntry()
}

val lengthsValid = lastFiles.forall(_._3 > 0L)
assert(offsetsValid, "Expected all offsets to be > 0")
assert(lengthsValid, "Expected all lengths to be > 0")

println(s"__CHECK__ lastNFiles retrieved ${lastFiles.length} entries: ${fileNames.mkString(", ")}")

val tile = rasterRDD.first()

var totalPixels = 0
var definedPixels = 0
var minX = Int.MaxValue
var maxX = Int.MinValue
var minY = Int.MaxValue
var maxY = Int.MinValue

// Iterate over all pixel locations in the tile
for ((x, y) <- tile.pixelLocations) {
  totalPixels += 1
  
  if (x < minX) minX = x
  if (x > maxX) maxX = x
  if (y < minY) minY = y
  if (y > maxY) maxY = y
  
  // Guard pixel access with isDefined as per documentation
  if (tile.isDefined(x, y)) {
    definedPixels += 1
  }
}

// Verify that the iterator yielded a complete dense grid of coordinates
val expectedTotal = (maxX - minX + 1) * (maxY - minY + 1)
assert(totalPixels > 0, "Tile should have at least one pixel")
assert(totalPixels == expectedTotal, s"Expected $expectedTotal pixels based on coordinate bounds, but got $totalPixels")

println(s"__CHECK__ pixelLocations total=$totalPixels, defined=$definedPixels")

import edu.ucr.cs.bdlab.beast.geolite.ITile

val firstTile: ITile[Float] = rasterRDD.first()
val pixelsArray = firstTile.pixels.toArray
val numPixels = pixelsArray.length

assert(numPixels > 0, "Tile should have at least one pixel")

val minCol = pixelsArray.map(_._1).min
val minRow = pixelsArray.map(_._2).min
val maxCol = pixelsArray.map(_._1).max
val maxRow = pixelsArray.map(_._2).max

// Verify that the coordinates are valid global grid coordinates
assert(minCol >= 0 && minRow >= 0, s"Expected valid global grid coordinates, got $minCol, $minRow")
assert(maxCol >= minCol && maxRow >= minRow, "Max coordinates should be >= min coordinates")

// Verify that each yielded pixel has a unique global coordinate
val uniqueCoords = pixelsArray.map(p => (p._1, p._2)).toSet.size
assert(uniqueCoords == numPixels, s"Expected $numPixels unique coordinates, but got $uniqueCoords")

println(s"__CHECK__ pixels $numPixels")

import edu.ucr.cs.bdlab.beast.common.BeastOptions
import edu.ucr.cs.bdlab.davinci.MVTDataVisualizer
import org.apache.hadoop.fs.Path

// Configure options for MVT generation
val opts = new BeastOptions().set("threshold", 0)

// Generate Mapbox Vector Tiles across zoom levels 0 to 2
val tiles = MVTDataVisualizer.plotAllTiles(
  featuresRDD, 
  levels = 0 to 2, 
  resolution = 256, 
  buffer = 5, 
  opts = opts
)

// Force materialization to verify the intermediate tiles RDD
val tileCount = tiles.count()
assert(tileCount > 0, "Expected at least one tile to be generated from featuresRDD")

// Save the generated tiles to a compact zip archive
val outPathStr = s"$output_dir/mvt.zip"
MVTDataVisualizer.saveTilesCompact(tiles, outPathStr, opts)

// Verify the output archive was successfully written and is not empty
val outPath = new Path(outPathStr)
val fs = outPath.getFileSystem(sc.hadoopConfiguration)
assert(fs.exists(outPath), "Expected MVT zip file to be created")
assert(fs.getFileStatus(outPath).getLen > 0, "Expected MVT zip file to be non-empty")

println(s"__CHECK__ plotAllTiles $tileCount")

import edu.ucr.cs.bdlab.beast.synopses.PointSampler

  assert(sample.nonEmpty, "Sample should not be empty when featuresRDD is not empty and sampleRatio is 1.0")

  assert(sample(0).length <= sampleSizeLimit, s"Sample size ${sample(0).length} exceeded limit $sampleSizeLimit")
  
  val numPoints = sample(0).length
  val firstX = sample(0)(0)
  val firstY = sample(1)(0)
  println(s"__CHECK__ pointSample $numPoints points. First: ($firstX, $firstY)")
} else {
  assert(sample.isEmpty, "Sample should be empty when featuresRDD is empty")
  println("__CHECK__ pointSample 0")
}

import java.io.{ByteArrayOutputStream, PrintStream}
import edu.ucr.cs.bdlab.beast.util.OperationHelper

// Retrieve an arbitrary registered operation to test the usage printer
val op = OperationHelper.operations.head._2

val baos = new ByteArrayOutputStream()
val printer = new PrintStream(baos)

// Print the operation usage to the byte array stream
OperationHelper.printOperationUsage(op, null, printer)

printer.flush()
printer.close()

val usageString = new String(baos.toByteArray)

// Verify that the usage string was successfully generated and written

// Generate the file partitions
val partitions = SpatialFileRDD.createPartitions(vector_geojson, opts, sc.hadoopConfiguration)
assert(partitions.length > 0, "Expected at least one partition to be created from the input file")

// Read the first partition safely with duplicate avoidance enabled
val firstPartitionFeatures = SpatialFileRDD.readPartition(partitions(0), readerClass, applyDuplicateAvoidance = true, opts).toList

// Correctness checks
val featureCount = firstPartitionFeatures.length
assert(featureCount > 0, "Expected to read at least one feature from the first partition")

val firstGeomType = firstPartitionFeatures.head.getGeometry.getGeometryType
assert(firstGeomType != null && firstGeomType.nonEmpty, "Expected a valid geometry type from the parsed feature")

println(s"__CHECK__ readPartition $featureCount features in first partition, first geometry type: $firstGeomType")

import org.geotools.referencing.CRS
import edu.ucr.cs.bdlab.beast.cg.Reprojector

val sourceCRS = CRS.decode("EPSG:4326", true)
val targetCRS = CRS.decode("EPSG:3857", true)

val originalGeometry = featuresRDD.first().getGeometry
val origCoordX = originalGeometry.getCoordinate.x
val origCoordY = originalGeometry.getCoordinate.y

val transformedGeom = Reprojector.reprojectGeometry(originalGeometry, sourceCRS, targetCRS)
val transCoord = transformedGeom.getCoordinate

assert(transformedGeom ne originalGeometry, "Reprojector should return a new Geometry instance")
assert(transformedGeom.getNumPoints == originalGeometry.getNumPoints, "Transformed geometry should have the same number of points")
assert(originalGeometry.getCoordinate.x == origCoordX && originalGeometry.getCoordinate.y == origCoordY, "Original geometry should not be mutated")

if (origCoordX != 0.0 && origCoordY != 0.0) {
  assert(origCoordX != transCoord.x || origCoordY != transCoord.y, "Coordinates should be transformed to the new CRS")
}

println(s"__CHECK__ reprojectGeometry original: (${origCoordX}, ${origCoordY}) -> transformed: (${transCoord.x}, ${transCoord.y})")

sumSideLength.code:
import edu.ucr.cs.bdlab.beast._

// Obtain the spatial summary from the features RDD
val summary = featuresRDD.summary

// Call sumSideLength to get the array of side lengths per dimension
val sideLengths: Array[Double] = summary.sumSideLength

// Manually compute the sum of side lengths to verify correctness
val manualSumSideLengths = featuresRDD
  .filter(f => f.getGeometry != null && !f.getGeometry.isEmpty)
  .map(f => {
    val env = f.getGeometry.getEnvelopeInternal
    (env.getWidth, env.getHeight)
  })
  .fold((0.0, 0.0))((a, b) => (a._1 + b._1, a._2 + b._2))

assert(sideLengths != null && sideLengths.length >= 2, "sumSideLength should return an array with at least 2 elements (X and Y)")
assert(Math.abs(sideLengths(0) - manualSumSideLengths._1) < 1e-5, s"Expected X sum ${manualSumSideLengths._1}, got ${sideLengths(0)}")
assert(Math.abs(sideLengths(1) - manualSumSideLengths._2) < 1e-5, s"Expected Y sum ${manualSumSideLengths._2}, got ${sideLengths(1)}")

val avgX = if (summary.numNonEmptyGeometries > 0) sideLengths(0) / summary.numNonEmptyGeometries else 0.0
val avgY = if (summary.numNonEmptyGeometries > 0) sideLengths(1) / summary.numNonEmptyGeometries else 0.0

println(s"__CHECK__ sumSideLength [${sideLengths.mkString(", ")}] (avgX: $avgX, avgY: $avgY)")
